documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong fourth quarter for FY26 with consolidated revenue from operations at Rs. 144 crores and sequential EBITDA growth. The Blue Pigment business benefited from stronger realizations supported by elevated raw material prices, while the AZO and API segments achieved EBITDA positivity and cash break-even for the full year. The company noted that backward integration and internal operational efficiencies supported margins despite a challenging global environment marked by geopolitical volatility and supply chain disruptions. Management highlighted strategic goals to improve capacity utilization, particularly in the API segment's finished goods, and expressed a long-term vision to reach Rs.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin of about 13% for the AZO business.
guidance.quote: For both answering on EBITDAs for both the ATC as well as Atlas business, we would guide that Management would like to target EBITDA margin of about 13% of the AZO business.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin of 15% to 16% in the API business going forward.
guidance.quote: And eventually, if we get the API business right, 15% to 16% in the API business going forward.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company has a goal of reaching Rs. 1000 crore as a company within the next few years.
guidance.quote: We will certainly be looking to grow, and we certainly have the goal of reaching Rs. 1000 crore as a company within the next few years.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q1 should be able to easily maintain the margins seen in Q4.
guidance.quote: So, Q1 should be able to easily maintain those in terms of our performance.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve Rs. 250 crores to Rs. 280 crores turnover at peak across Chattral and Atlas without doing any CAPEX.
guidance.quote: So, basically in short answer of your question, we can achieve both facilities, Chattral and Atlas, we can achieve Rs. 250 crores - Rs. 280 crores turnover at peak without doing any CAPEX and we can achieve 15%-16% of EBITDA margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Europe has had a structural slowdown in demand.
demand_outlook.quote: For Europe as well, I think generally Europe has had a structural slowdown in demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the American business has started to improve once tariffs were reduced.
demand_outlook.quote: So, our US business, once the tariff has been reduced again, it has again started to improve.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that a meaningful expansion and addition of an AZO line would require a CAPEX of Rs. 10 crores to Rs. 15 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And this would help us boost the capacity by almost, it would go to 1.5x. So, the investment as opposed to what we get in return would be substantially better because of the earlier investment and strategy we have made to make the civil structure and several other parts of the factory already ready for this expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the EBITDA margin expanded to 15.6% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin as well expanded to 15.6% in Q4 FY26 compared to 8.58% in Q3 FY26 and 11.53% in Q4 FY25, once again representing an expansion of 407 basis points year-on-year and 702 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that Chinese manufacturers have increased prices by 30% to 40% due to reduced export incentives, doubled ocean freight, and basic raw material price increases.
margins_costs.quote: So, in general, Chinese has increased around 30% to 40% of their price because of all three reasons.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported a one-time benefit in power and fuel costs relating to billing charges incurred on renewable energy.
margins_costs.quote: So, as I mentioned, it was basically to do with the billing charges that is incurred on renewable energy and we were able to get that which was pending to be gotten for two years at a one-shot payment after a discussion and being able to use the Renewable Laws correctly.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the Chattral plant intermediate utilization is around 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: At Chattral plant, well, we are going at a utilization level around 70%, which is good for the intermediate level.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the API finished good utilization remains very low around 30%.
orders_capacity.quote: However, on the API front, the finished good utilization once again remains very low. It would be somewhere around 30%, and that is where we look to improve our fixed asset turnover for the API business

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the AZO utilization levels are currently hovering around 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, in the Pigment section, the APC business of AZO, the utilization levels are currently hovering around 65% and there is opportunity to take this utilization levels forward to about 75% to 85% before we are required to push a small CAPEX to increase capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that interest costs declined due to ongoing debt reduction.
capital_allocation.quote: The interest costs declined to Rs. 3.30 crores in Q4, down 14.15% year-on-year, reflecting our ongoing debt reduction.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that peak debt had risen to Rs. 220 crores during the CAPEX cycle and is now dropping faster than internally estimated.
capital_allocation.quote: This seems to have turned and our basic EBITDA has been as a Group level going up and will probably likely continue. And the debt is dropping faster than we had even internally estimated.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that raw material prices remain elevated and global supply chains have seen a lot of disruption.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment continues to present challenges, with raw material prices remaining elevated and global supply chains having seen a lot of disruption.

management_commitments.claim: Management is confident of obtaining CEP Certification by the end of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: On the regulatory front, as I have briefed before, progress is being made towards achieving our CEP Certification and we are confident that by the end of the current financial year we would be able to get this certification

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the AZO business is expected to achieve PBT break-even next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. We should definitely expect that and I think as I have guided as well for us in terms of performance, while we have been slow, it has been a steady positive performance and we are hopeful and confident that we will achieve that.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve peak turnover and EBITDA margins across Chattral and Atlas facilities in the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, in next 2-3 years we will achieve this.
